title: User's Guide for Evaluating Subsurface Vapor Intrusion into Buildings (Revised February 22, 2004)

table.description: Transcription of the 'Chemical Properties Lookup Table' printed in the VLOOKUP tables of Appendix C (PDF pages 113 and 114, 108 chemicals): CAS number, chemical name, normal boiling point T_B (K), critical temperature T_C (K), enthalpy of vaporization at the normal boiling point (cal/mol). Appendix B prints a shorter copy (95 chemicals, PDF pages 106 and 107) at three significant figures; it is used only for the enthalpy flags.
table.flagColumns: dhvbAtNormalBoilingPoint is false where Appendix B marks the enthalpy as taken at a temperature other than the normal boiling point, or where the printed value is not a usable cal/mol figure (see note).
